response: Advocate Position: Defend on-field call under IFAB VAR Protocol Section 3 and Law 5 ('Spirit of the Game'). Referee István Kovács had an unobstructed direct sightline (22m distance). Contact occurred during an unpressured defensive restart with no active attacking phase, where Marc Pubill acted under a good-faith belief that the Law 16 goal-kick sequence was being reset, supporting the high Clear & Obvious threshold for non-intervention.

Audit Objection: IFAB Law 16.1 explicitly dictates 'The ball is in play when it is kicked and clearly moves.' Once goalkeeper Musso kicked the ball 8.4m, the restart was legally consummated. IFAB Law 12.1 categorizes deliberate hand contact inside the penalty area as an objective, non-interpretative penalty offense with zero 'Spirit of the Game' exemption. In Aston Villa vs. Club Brugge (PREC-UCL-2024-MINGS), UEFA confirmed a mandatory penalty against Tyrone Mings under identical spatial mechanics (98.4% telemetry parity).

Arbitration Finding: Overturn warranted. The IFAB VAR Protocol Section 3 'Clear and Obvious Error' threshold was decisively breached because the two-hand pickup occurred on a live ball inside the penalty box (13.2m, 26.5m). 98.4% statistical parity with PREC-UCL-2024-MINGS (Tyrone Mings) under IFAB Law 16.1 and Law 12.1 dictates a mandatory penalty kick. Precedent Deviation Index: 92%.

Advocate Position: Defend Referee Clément Turpin's on-field assessment under IFAB VAR Protocol Section 3. Goalkeeper Juan Musso is entitled to contest aerial balls within his penalty area. His eyes remained fixed on the flight of the ball, and plant-leg deceleration reduced biomechanical transfer to a mutual aerial collision within the referee's subjective Law 12 physical tolerance corridor.

Audit Objection: IFAB Law 12.3 explicitly mandates that any challenge that 'endangers the safety of an opponent or uses excessive force' must be sanctioned as serious foul play. OptaVision telemetry confirms Musso missed the ball completely and impacted Fermín López's cranial/facial zone with exposed studs at 1.48m elevation (24.8 kN). Per Sadio Mané vs. Ederson (PREC-EPL-2017-MANE, 91.2% parity), lack of malice is legally irrelevant when player cranial safety is endangered.

Arbitration Finding: Severe officiating error confirmed. Penalizing the attacker when the goalkeeper missed the ball and made stud-to-head contact at 1.48m directly violates IFAB Law 12.3 and PREC-EPL-2017-MANE. VAR was required to recommend an On-Field Review for a penalty kick and disciplinary sanction. Precedent Deviation Index: 86%.

Advocate Position: Support the VAR-recommended DOGSO dismissal under IFAB Law 12.3. Forward Alexander Sørloth had breached the central defensive line at 32.4m with direct alignment toward goal. Once Eric García's trailing knee clipped Sørloth's heel from behind, an obvious goal-scoring opportunity was denied under VAR Protocol Section 3.

Audit Objection: IFAB Law 12.3 establishes four cumulative criteria for DOGSO: distance to goal (32.4m), general direction of play, likelihood of keeping control (heavy touch angling wide), and location/number of defenders. World Model geometry proves covering defender Jules Koundé was 4.2m away inside the recovery cone closing at 7.8 m/s. Per PREC-EPL-2021-LUIZ (David Luiz), incidental heel contact with covering recovery mandates Stopping a Promising Attack (SPA — Yellow Card), not a straight red card.

Arbitration Interim Finding: Marginal consistency divergence (PDI 58%). While trailing contact occurred, Criterion 3 (distance 32.4m with heavy touch) and Criterion 4 (Koundé 4.2m covering cone) create substantial doubt under IFAB Law 12.3. Remanding to Round 2 adversarial cross-examination on covering defender interception.

Advocate Rebuttal (Round 2): Countering the Auditor's Criterion 4 objection under IFAB Law 12.3 and VAR Protocol Section 3: although Koundé was within a 4.2m lateral radius, Sørloth possessed inside body leverage. Once the on-field referee reviewed the monitor, upgrading to DOGSO fell within UEFA's strict punishment of unattempted-ball heel clips from behind.

Auditor Cross-Examination (Round 2): Under IFAB Law 12.3, the 'attempt to play the ball' mitigation applies only inside the penalty area; outside the box at 32.4m, all four DOGSO pillars must be objectively satisfied. Kinematic projection confirms Koundé's 7.8 m/s vector intersects the ball at 24.1m before shot execution, matching PREC-EPL-2021-LUIZ (84.2% similarity) where VAR intervention was ruled an over-application of DOGSO.

Final Arbitration Finding (Round 2): Threshold breach confirmed. Because Koundé's 4.2m recovery vector and the 32.4m distance negate IFAB Law 12.3 DOGSO Criteria 1 and 4, Clément Turpin's initial play-on/SPA corridor was not a 'Clear and Obvious Error' under VAR Protocol Section 3. Proper sanction: Yellow Card (SPA). Precedent Deviation Index: 58%.
